#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string st;
    getline(cin, st);
    
    // Step 1: take first character
    char p = st[0];
    // Remove first character and replace all "dot" with "."
    string rest = st.substr(1);
    size_t pos = 0;
    while ((pos = rest.find("dot", pos)) != string::npos) {
        rest.replace(pos, 3, ".");
        pos += 1;
    }
    st = p + rest;
    
    // Step 2: if last char is '.', replace it with "dot"
    if (!st.empty() && st.back() == '.') {
        st.pop_back();
        st += "dot";
    }
    
    // Step 3: take first character again
    p = st[0];
    rest = st.substr(1);
    // Replace first occurrence of "at" with "@"
    pos = rest.find("at");
    if (pos != string::npos) {
        rest.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }
    st = rest;
    
    // Step 4: if last char is '@', replace it with "at"
    if (!st.empty() && st.back() == '@') {
        st.pop_back();
        st += "at";
    }
    
    // Output
    cout << p << st << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
